items.summary: Lions All-Pro linebacker Jack Campbell was placed on a backboard and carted off the field early in the fourth quarter Sunday against the Vikings.

items.title: Lamar headed to IR with 'potentially' season-ending thumb injury
items.summary: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson needs to have surgery on his injured right thumb and will be placed on injured reserve, coach Jesse Minter said.

items.title: Steelers answer Verse's trash talk with big win: 'Should have kept his mouth shut'
items.summary: The Steelers got the last word after Browns defensive end Jared Verse's trash talk ahead of Sunday's matchup.
